quick.summary: How to make sure your new features all fit together perfectly.
quick.takeaway: Use the big picture to decide what to build and what to skip.

beats.line: We shipped five features this month. But the product feels messy.
Everything feels completely disconnected. Why is that happening?
Think of a tea stall. They sell tea and nice biscuits.
If they suddenly sell shoes, the buyers will get very confused.
Your work needs a single direction to hold it all together.
We call this guiding light a product north star.
Can I just say the big picture?
Yes. The big picture guides every single choice you make.
So we check every new task against that main picture.
If a task does not fit, you do not build it.

quiz.question: What happens when a product lacks a clear big picture?
options: Features feel disconnected and confuse the buyer.
The team writes code much faster.
Every feature automatically becomes a huge success.
The product owner gets a massive promotion.
quiz.explanation: Without a guiding vision, a product becomes a messy collection of features that confuses users.

quiz.question: You should reject a new feature if it does not fit the big picture.
quiz.explanation: The big picture exists to help you say no to things that distract from your main goal.
